hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A subarray sum is divisible by k if the prefix remainder mod k equals the suffix remainder mod k.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Negating an element x replaces sum with sum minus two x, changing the prefix remainder by (-2 * x) mod k.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Store the earliest occurrence of each remainder state and test candidate negated elements across the window.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Prefix remainder tracking with earliest position lookup per remainder modulo k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subarrays with every possible negation takes O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores earliest occurrences of each remainder modulo k.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses remainder difference algebra to evaluate negation effect.
